title: Disconnection Notices and the Business Security Deposit Multiple
content:
Disconnection notices raise the multiple applied to the recalculated requirement of a held business Security Deposit.

**Rule.** Two or more disconnection notices issued on the secured Electric Service Agreement in the 12 months ending on the recalculation date add 0.5 to the multiple; exactly one adds 0.25; none adds nothing.

| Disconnection notices on the secured agreement in the 12 months | Added to the multiple |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 0.5 |
| Exactly one | 0.25 |
| None | Nothing |

Each disconnection notice on the agreement's record counts as one, whether written or final; notices on the customer's other agreements are not counted.

## Cases (hypothetical notice histories)

- A written notice 4 months and a final notice 3 months before the recalculation date: two notices, 0.5 added.
- One written notice 11 months before the recalculation date: 0.25 added.
- One written notice 13 months before the recalculation date: outside the 12 months, nothing added.
